metadata.source_non_agriculture: ISTAT ASIA ATECO5 annual employment, project panel 2018-2023
metadata.source_agriculture: ISTAT territorial accounts SDMX 93_379, agriculture employed persons, project Module 36A
metadata.interpretation: 2018-2023 are observed project employment data. 2035 is a composition-only structural scenario, not a forecast of the four work-intensity classes.
metadata.agriculture_caveat: Agriculture employment is from a different statistical source/concept than non-agriculture ASIA. Use the non_ag_ASIA scope for a source-homogeneous view and whole_project for consistency with the paper's full project denominator.
